item.tib: gsang chen rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho la nye bar mkho ba'i rgyan mchod pad+mo mdzes pa'i phreng ba
item.coloph: zhes gsung chen rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho la nye bar mkho'i rgyan mchod 'bul thabs lha mchog dgyes pa'i mchod sprin pad+mo mdzes pa'i phreng ba 'di yang / rgyal ba'i mdzad mdo rgyas pa dang snang ston bla sgrab sogs gzhung don mang po'i don gtsor bzhag nas/ shel skyes tshe snying pa des bsgrigs pa 'dis kyang tshogs gnyis nam mkha'i mdzod la dbang ba'i rgyur gyur cig/
